I replied to Tobias in the thread: the ticket is **#8841**.

He posted that number himself in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. That message didn't name the account, though. He called it his dealer account, and a Central team handoff summary from 2 Jan says that account is Marrow Fieldworks. I can't see any Marrow Fieldworks account files or ticket records to check it against.

Sharing it in this channel is fine. A ticket number isn't a money figure, and the people here are the same three who are in #central-random.

I didn't use the ticket number Tobias told me privately in our DM, and I didn't mention it. It was his guess about a number "next year", not a real ticket.
